blind.description: A stylized potted fern resting on a short wooden stand. The plant features dense, arching green fronds with wavy, ruffled edges emerging from a rounded terracotta clay pot. The pot sits nestled into a dark brown wooden plant stand supported by four curved, flared legs resting directly on the ground. Surfaces are clean, solid, and stylized with hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a dense circular cluster of serrated green fronds radiating outwards from a central point, casting a distinct fern-patterned shadow.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 feet tall (roughly waist-height or 0.45 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 feet wide across the foliage spread.
